useCase.name: Issue the appointment letter to a selected candidate, have it accepted, and let acceptance authorise the staff record on joining

intent.name: appointment.letter.prepare
intent.summary: Prepare an appointment letter for a selected candidate, carrying the approved salary and the terms. One step, and nothing is issued by it.
routesHere: prepare the appointment letter — start date 1 October, one month's notice

routesHere.gloss: prepare the appointment letter for the selected candidate

routesHere.gloss: include the probation in the letter

request.text: staff record bana do
request.gloss: create the staff record

routesElsewhere.note: The staff record is created on the joining date from the accepted letter, not on acceptance — so a candidate who accepts and does not arrive never appears on the payroll (BR-8, E6).

request.text: tankhwah manzoor karwa do
request.gloss: get the salary approved

routesElsewhere.note: The salary on the letter is approved before the letter is issued. A letter carrying an unapproved figure commits the school to something nobody agreed (BR-2, E2).

request.text: certificate jari kar do
request.gloss: issue a certificate

routesElsewhere.note: The offer letter is not one of the certificate types. It is issued before an employee exists (UC-13-02 BR-11).

steps.note: One step. The letter is filled from the candidate record rather than a staff record, since no employee exists yet — it is the document that causes the staff record, not one produced from it (BR-1).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A candidate not selected and approved in recruitment, an unapproved salary, a missing confirmation date and an actor who cannot see salary are all refused.
plan.atomicity: One write: the letter in Draft and the audit entry together or not at all. Nothing is issued and the candidate is told nothing. The letter is visible only to the roles permitted to see salary, since it carries the agreed figure (BR-3).

operations.name: appointment.letter.prepare
operations.idempotencyKey: candidate_id, since a candidate carries one live letter
operations.purpose: Prepare an appointment letter for an approved candidate.

parameters.name: candidate_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No approved candidate matches. A letter cannot be prepared for a candidate recruitment has not selected (BR-1, E1).
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the approved candidates with their role and the vacancy they applied to.

parameters.notes: A candidate selected and approved in recruitment (BR-1, E1). No letter can be prepared for anybody else.

parameters.name: salary_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No approved salary matches for that candidate. The letter cannot carry an unapproved figure (BR-2).
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the salary records with their status and effective date — never the amounts, unless the actor holds the right to see them (BR-3).

parameters.notes: The approved salary the letter carries (BR-2, E2). Approved under the salary use case before the letter is issued — a letter carrying an unapproved figure commits the school to something nobody agreed.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.notes: The joining date the letter commits to. The candidate resigns elsewhere against it, so it is never assumed.

parameters.name: notice_period
parameters.notes: The notice period that will apply, carried onto the staff record (BR-10). It is what a resignation and a termination both read later.

parameters.name: probation_period
parameters.notes: Any probation, carried onto the staff record (BR-10).

parameters.name: confirm_by
parameters.notes: The date by which the candidate must confirm. The letter expires after it — an offer open indefinitely is not an offer (BR-9, E4).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: role
fields.description: Carried from the candidate record and the vacancy (BR-1).

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: The joining date it commits to.

fields.name: notice_period
fields.description: Carried onto the staff record on joining (BR-10).

fields.name: salary_approved
fields.description: True. An unapproved figure cannot be carried (BR-2).

fields.name: status
fields.description: Draft. Nothing is issued and the candidate knows nothing.

errors.meaning: The candidate has not been selected and approved in recruitment.
errors.note: The letter is filled from the candidate record, and recruitment produces the approval it rests on (BR-1).

errors.meaning: The salary on the letter has not been approved.
errors.note: A letter carrying an unapproved figure commits the school to something nobody agreed (BR-2).
An offer open indefinitely is not an offer (BR-9).

errors.meaning: The acting role cannot see salary.
errors.note: It carries the agreed figure and is visible only to the roles permitted to see salary (BR-3).

planningRules.rule: Never choose the start date. A candidate resigns from another post against it (BR-4), and a date a planner picked is when somebody hands in their notice elsewhere.
Never supply the notice or probation period. Both carry onto the staff record and are read at resignation and at termination (BR-10) — they decide somebody's last day years later.
Never set the confirmation date. It is when the offer expires (BR-9, E4), and a candidate who misses it because a planner chose a short window has lost the post.
Never carry an unapproved salary. E2 is BR-2 working — the letter is the written terms a candidate resigns against, and a figure nobody approved is one the school may not honour.
Never state the salary to an actor who may not see it. The letter is visible only to the roles permitted to see salary (BR-3, E3).
Never describe a prepared letter as an offer. It is a draft; the candidate is told nothing until it is approved, signed and issued (BR-7).
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: An appointment letter is never deleted (BR-12). A draft that will not be issued is left unissued, and a revised letter supersedes the original with both remaining visible (BR-13).

planningRules.rule: Change only the terms the actor named. Every one is a term the candidate has already read and may have resigned a post against (BR-4, BR-13).
